lines.name: Jess
lines.text: Celeste support, this is Jess speaking.

lines.name: Noah Kim
lines.text: Hi, it's Noah Kim. I'm stuck. Every time I open a friend's chart from a compatibility reading, the app signs me out, and then it says my sign-in link has expired.

lines.name: Jess
lines.text: Oh no. Have you tried closing the app and opening it again?

lines.name: Noah Kim
lines.text: Yes, and I reinstalled it. It happens every time. And Restore purchase still does nothing, so my monthly forecast is locked. It's completely blocking me.

lines.name: Jess
lines.text: I'm sorry, Noah. I'll send you a new sign-in link and flag this with the app team today.
